description: Existing swap-standard xswap probe and fast screening capabilities. Readiness still requires a validated frozen protocol and runtime evidence.
limitations: Plain-mode full correctness is unavailable in the current runner.
Counter shifts and exact-tree reviewed structural evidence are supported; per-operation cost and lock-trace adapters remain unavailable.
Fast evidence is exploratory; independent confirmation and code promotion remain separate decisions.
Profile membership does not approve a new protocol revision or kernel experiment.
